title: Black Forest Shop Dashboard 1.0.2 (Windows Setup + Portable)
notes:
Primary: **Black.Forest.Shop.Dashboard-Setup.exe** — one-click Windows install (same spirit as Tools Setup):

- Clones/updates `%USERPROFILE%\\bf-shop-dashboard` from `main`
- Desktop + Start Menu shortcuts
- 30-minute git auto-update (`BlackForestShopDashboardUpdate`)
- Settings → Check for updates
- Optional login autostart

Private source repo: sign in to GitHub as BlackForestPorsche (or collaborator). No secrets in the Setup.

Secondary: **BlackForestShopDashboard-win-x64.zip** — Portable (unzip + VBS; no git auto-update).

Dashboard package version **1.0.2**.
